categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds functional test coverage for outbound connection management, including stale-tip extra connections, block-relay-only peer rotation, and network diversification.
categories.rationale: Adds end-to-end test coverage for core P2P outbound connection management heuristics that were previously difficult to test. As noted in the description, it tests autonomous connection decisions merged across past PRs (#11560, #19858, #27213) without altering node logic.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Label 'Tests' and changes to `test/functional/test_framework/test_framework.py` adding `auto_outbound_mode` and SOCKS5 proxy redirection machinery.
categories.rationale: Introduces a generalized framework capability for nodes to autonomously initiate outbound connections to simulated peers via a proxy. This deduplicates proxy redirect machinery previously isolated in `p2p_private_broadcast.py` and enables end-to-end outbound P2P tests.
